title: Upwork
notes: The strongest general freelance platform for your profile because it supports senior consulting, technology strategy, software consulting, program management and long-term client engagements. Connects and platform competition make indiscriminate proposals expensive. Apply selectively.

title: Toptal
notes: A premium target for senior consulting and project-management work. The selection process is demanding, but your 18+ years and enterprise-scale portfolio support a credible application. Admission is selective and category-specific. Do not claim platform-specific expertise you cannot demonstrate.

title: Wellfound
notes: A high-priority source for startup CTO, Head of Technology, engineering-management, product, data, cloud and architecture roles with salary and equity visibility. Many roles are geography-restricted or equity-heavy. Review funding, runway and compensation carefully.

title: FlexJobs
type: Curated remote and flexible job board
notes: A strong source for remote full-time, freelance, flexible and director-level technology roles, especially when you need curated remote listings. Some features require membership. A remote label does not always mean worldwide eligibility.

title: We Work Remotely
notes: A strong remote board for technical program management, product, DevOps, infrastructure, software and management-consulting opportunities. Many remote vacancies remain country or time-zone restricted despite appearing on a global board.

title: Contra
notes: Strong for portfolio-led independent consulting, global project discovery, professional visibility, contracts and commission-free payments. Some opportunity access and advanced visibility features may require a paid plan.

title: Fiverr
notes: Best used by packaging your expertise into clearly scoped consulting services rather than bidding on conventional job vacancies. Fiverr is seller-led. Success depends on service packaging, reviews, positioning and response speed.

title: Freelancer.com
notes: Useful for project-based consulting, cloud, architecture, program-management and enterprise-system engagements, but proposals must be filtered carefully to avoid low-value work. Open bidding creates strong price competition. Confirm scope, client verification and milestone funding.

title: PeoplePerHour
notes: A secondary source for consulting, software, IT and project-management assignments. Suitable opportunities exist, but average project sizes may be below your target level. Use careful budget filtering and avoid competing for low-value commodity tasks.

title: Guru
notes: Useful as a secondary project source for technology, cloud, software, operations and project-management work. Client quality and project depth vary. Verify payment, scope and employer history.

title: LinkedIn Jobs
notes: Strongest platform for your profile because senior roles are often promoted through employer pages and professional networks.

title: Canonical Careers
notes: Direct source for Canonical roles across engineering, support engineering, project management, product, commercial operations, sales, cloud, Linux, infrastructure and remote work.

title: Indeed Egypt
notes: Use exact senior-role keywords and verify whether the application is hosted by Indeed or redirects to the employer.

title: Glassdoor
notes: Best used alongside an official employer page to validate company reputation, salary and interview expectations.

title: WUZZUF
notes: A major Egypt-focused recruitment platform with regional expansion.

title: LoopCV
notes: Use strict filters and manual review for senior roles. Avoid uncontrolled high-volume applications that may reduce application quality.

title: Google Interview Warmup
notes: Career-preparation tool rather than a vacancy platform.

title: Workana
notes: Useful for consulting and project-based income rather than senior permanent executive employment.
